tagline: Offline Torah Notes & Hebrew Handwriting OCR Studio
taglineHebrew: סטודיו אופליין לזיהוי ועריכת כתב יד תורני ומחברות שיעורים
releaseTitle: v1.3.2 — One-Click 'Install Now' In-App Updater & OCR Segmentation Reliability
description: Ohr HaKsav (אור הכתב) v1.3.2 adds a prominent one-click 'Install Update Now' button directly inside the Check for Updates modal, enabling seamless in-app background downloading and automated execution of updates without manual browsing.
features: One-Click 'Install Update Now': Added a prominent action button to download and launch update installers directly from the update modal with live progress.
Reinstall & Repair Mode: Users running the latest version can easily reinstall or repair their installation with a single click.
Eliminated OCR Python Metadata Leak: Completely removes dictionary debug dumps from transcribed notes.
Automatic Desk Background Cropping: Automatically trims dark table surfaces when notebook pages are photographed with a smartphone.
Stabilized Line Pitch for Ruled Notebooks: Prevents notebook ruling and loose-leaf margins from collapsing text into single-letter vertical slivers.
